name: Mixing Up Tiki Blackstrap Tea
description: A non-alcoholic English breakfast tea base flavored with blackstrap molasses, nutmeg, and cinnamon, used as a dark rum stand-in for non-alcoholic tiki drinks.
instructions: Combine 375 ml water, 9.375 g English breakfast tea, 2 g nutmeg, 3 g cinnamon, and 1 tsp blackstrap molasses.
